g.text: Verify connected MCP tools and selected writable folder
Strict boot and workspace health check
Read privacy-safe inventory and timing data
Explain what to provide and why
Add CV (PDF, DOCX, or HTML), job, evidence, voice
Preserve source, extract locally, build evidence inventory
Ask for photo choice and cover-letter signature
Build editable HTML CV and cover-letter draft
Review CV and confirm or accept stated risks
Record current CV review against artifact hash
Send only chosen cover-letter text for review
Verify distinct current drafts before release receipt
HTML/PDF outputs, readiness report, and receipt
Original files stay local; your AI client processes them under its own policy.
MCP receives only an allowed manifest, selected writing, or selected CV/JD text for ATS.
Missing required conversion/visual/review evidence blocks the affected release.
The service returns guidance; it does not expose private checker rules.
